title: Opposite reversal of joins and internal functor simplicial sets
statement:
Use simplicial sets, internal functor simplicial sets and universes of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], opposite simplicial sets as defined in clause (4) of [lem-coef-infinity-relative-cone-equivalence], and the left join and fat left cone of [lem-coef-infinity-join-cone-calculus]. Let $K,S$ be small simplicial sets and $\mathcal E$ a quasicategory in a containing universe. Define $K\star\Delta^0$ by ordered blocks of $K$-vertices followed by vertices at a new final vertex. There are natural simplicial isomorphisms
$$(K\star\Delta^0)^{\mathrm{op}}\cong\Delta^0\star K^{\mathrm{op}},\qquad \operatorname{Fun}(S,\mathcal E)^{\mathrm{op}}\cong\operatorname{Fun}(S^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal E^{\mathrm{op}}).$$
The first reverses the ordered join blocks. In degree $n$, the second sends $h:S\times\Delta^n\to\mathcal E$ to $h^{\mathrm{op}}:S^{\mathrm{op}}\times(\Delta^n)^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal E^{\mathrm{op}}$, using the vertex-reversal identification $(\Delta^n)^{\mathrm{op}}\cong\Delta^n$. They commute with restriction along every simplicial map of shapes, in particular $K\hookrightarrow K\star\Delta^0$, and with evaluation at the apex. Let $u_K:K\times\Delta^1\to K\star\Delta^0$ split each interval simplex into its initial $0$-vertices in $K$ and final $1$-vertices at the apex. After reversal of $K$, the parameter simplices and the interval, $u_K^{\mathrm{op}}$ is the map $K^{\mathrm{op}}\times\Delta^1\to\Delta^0\star K^{\mathrm{op}}$ collapsing the initial $0$-vertices to the apex and retaining the final $1$-vertices in $K^{\mathrm{op}}$, namely the map factoring through the fat left cone in that node.
